This Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) establishes the mandatory metallurgical, dimensional, and
weld-integrity protocols for fabricating main battle tank (MBT) armoured hulls using Rolled Homogeneous

bays must enforce controlled pre-heating, austenitic/low-hydrogen filler wire selection, multi-pass submerged
arc and pulse-GMAW sequencing, and 100% ultrasonic phased-array inspection to prevent hydrogen-induced
cold cracking and ballistic seam failure.
